svg.text: Breadboard layout: Cmod A7-35T, INMP441, GY-PCM5102 and the 3.3 V regulator

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Board configuration cmod_a7_35_no_pll_tiny_vga_304_no_tm1638_claude, seen from above. The microphone, the DAC and the 3.3 V regulator of variant B go straight into the breadboard; TinyVGA connects as in the wiring diagrams.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tinted holes are the strips in use: the five holes of a strip are connected. A dot is a jumper wire in a hole.

svg.text: +3.3 V from the regulator (variant A: from TPH2)

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Both + rails and both GND rails are joined at the far end.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: INMP441 goes across the center channel like a 6-pin DIP chip, SCK, WS, L/R on the side of DIP 25 to 48. L/R goes to GND here, so DIP 31 stays free.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The DAC goes in by its header in column j; its body and jack hang over the bottom rails and the edge of the breadboard, so it takes its power from the top rails.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The regulator of variant B is a 3-pin AMS1117-3.3 module, as Amazon B08CDMZMDN. It goes in by its header in column j, rows 24 to 26, so VIN is in the strip of DIP 24, VU, and no wire carries 5 V.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Its pin order, VIN, GND, VOUT from the Cmod A7 end, and its outline come from the listing: check the labels. If VIN is at the other end, connect the module by wires as in the variant B wiring diagram.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Variant A, Pmod TPH2: leave the regulator out and wire test point 6 of TPH2 to the + rail; DIP 24, VU, then stays unconnected.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keep the middle of rows 25 to 29 free for the USB plug. Unplug USB before changing the wiring.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: DIP 1 to 14, 17 to 20 and 33 to 48 are the GPIO pins of the labs, gpio[0] to gpio[33]; nothing is connected to them here.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: GY-PCM5102: the pin order differs between board versions: connect by the labels. SCK goes to GND. Solder jumpers: FLT L, DEMP L, XSMT H, FMT L.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Only the 6-pin header may go into the breadboard: keep any other pins of the board off the holes.
